records.statement: The evaluator only waits until a signal is at least 24 hours old, then uses the single current CoinGecko price at the next daily run. With a 23:55 UTC daily schedule, effective horizons vary; no checked_at timestamp is stored, so exact horizons cannot be reconstructed.

Scores above 60 are judged on any positive price move, below 40 on non-positive move, and 40–60 on absolute return below 2%. The resulting 45.5% combines different targets and is not directional accuracy, probability calibration or out-of-sample skill.

Among 1,697 checked records, 1,119 (65.9%) are fallback/no-sentiment records with confidence 0 and source strings reporting missing GitHub model credentials and Groq HTTP 429. Their 49.69% legacy hit rate is descriptive only. The 578 Groq-labelled records average 0.947 confidence but have a 37.37% legacy hit rate; this is not a formal calibration test.
Nineteen history records from 2026-09-29 through 2026-09-30 remain unchecked because price_at_emission is zero. The evaluator skips them; the cause of the zero emission price is not recorded.

Signals were emitted at a median interval of about 0.982 hours, creating heavily overlapping forecast windows. The 1,697 checked records are not independent observations; no purge/embargo or effective sample-size adjustment is applied.
